name: Window
access: OML creates this object from a selector:Window node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique name. Required.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Number, px, percent, or a size expression. Required.

properties.name: min_width
properties.description: Minimum width. Optional.

properties.name: max_width
properties.description: Maximum width. Optional.

properties.name: min_height
properties.description: Minimum height. Optional.

properties.name: max_height
properties.description: Maximum height. Optional.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Title. Optional.

properties.name: scroll
properties.description: Scrollable body. Defaults to false. Optional.

properties.name: blur
properties.description: The window handles view blur and focus. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: html
properties.description: HTML appended to the window view. Optional.

properties.name: template
properties.description: Template appended to the window view. Optional.

properties.name: view
properties.description: View config instantiated in the default container. Optional.

properties.name: css
properties.description: Custom CSS class. Optional.

properties.name: head
properties.description: HEAD_NONE, HEAD_CLOSE, HEAD_BACK, or the strings none, close, back. Defaults to HEAD_BACK. Optional.

properties.name: position
properties.description: POSITION_LEFT, POSITION_RIGHT, POSITION_TOP, POSITION_BOTTOM, or left, right, top, bottom. Defaults to left. Optional.

properties.name: anim
properties.description: Defaults to false. A string is a class added while the window moves. Direction is position. There is no ANIM_LEFT constant. Optional.

properties.name: zindex
properties.description: Z-index. Optional.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Main icon. Optional.

properties.name: icons
properties.description: Toolbar icons. Optional.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Read as {{$}} when the OML content renders. Optional.

catalog_status: Listed fields are OML config from the OGX.JS wiki. Methods are not listed. Use inherited true for documented base classes. Do not invent members that are absent.
